senses.gloss: (b. h.;cmp. Sam. לבט = ענה, Ex. XXII, 21, sq.) to knock about, to send from place to place. Mekh. B’shall., Amal., s. 2 שאברהם לא לְבָטוּהוּ when Abraham was to be shown the holy land (Gen. XIII, 14) they did not trouble him to leave his place, ומשה לְבָטוּהוּ but Moses they did put to the trouble &c. (Deut. III, 27).—Part. pass. לָבוּט, pl. לְבוּטִים outcasts.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 52">Gen. R. s. 52</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="L00064">next w.</cite>

senses.gloss: to be troubled; to go from place to place.
